verdict.rationale: HRIS/payroll stakeholder sync is a fair question for an equity management platform like Qapita, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions integrations with Gusto, Rippling or any HRIS/payroll system, or automatic syncing of new hires and terminations into equity records. The cited items cover only cap table, ESOP, valuation, reporting and fund-admin features.
